svg.text: I'm a full stack engineer who enjoys owning a feature
from the first screen to the last database query.
Day to day I work across React and Next.js on the web, React Native and
Expo on mobile, and Node.js, TypeScript and Python on the server. More of
my recent work involves AI and machine learning, from computer vision to
I care about clear code and calm releases, and I try to leave things in a state
the next developer can pick up without a long handover.
